title: GameDev.net
description: Search and cite GameDev.net forums, tutorials, postmortems, and game-industry news.
summary: Search and cite GameDev.net forums, tutorials, postmortems, and game-industry news.
offersHint: Search and cite GameDev.net forums, tutorials, postmortems, and game-industry news. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://gamedev.net/mcp/

toolsPreview.name: search_site
toolsPreview.description: Unified full-text search across all public GameDev.net content — forum discussions, tutorials, blogs, projects, portfolios, and game-industry news. Filter to specific kinds with content_types (e.g. ["forum_topic","forum_post"] for forums, or ["news","news_item"] for news) and order by relevance or date. Returns titles, URLs, excerpts, authors, and ids for follow-up with get_content.

toolsPreview.name: get_thread
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one GameDev.net forum thread with its posts (plain text), including which reply is the accepted answer.

toolsPreview.name: get_content
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full public text of a specific item (tutorial, blog, news, project, portfolio, forum topic, canonical answer, or thread digest) using the content_type + id from a search result. Use this to ground deeply after a search. For news_item (aggregated news) this returns GameDev.net's own AI summary and enrichment with a citation link, not the source's full article text.

toolsPreview.name: list_recent
toolsPreview.description: List the most recent GameDev.net content of a given kind. Useful for "what is new" / roundup queries. Includes the curated canonical answers and "best of" thread digests.

toolsPreview.name: list_trending_content
toolsPreview.description: What is currently trending in game-industry news on GameDev.net. mode="stories" (default) returns deduplicated multi-source story clusters (with aggregated tags, source count, and when the story broke/last updated — use get_story for the full timeline); mode="items" returns individual trending articles. Each result carries GameDev.net's owned AI summary and a source citation. Optionally filter by tag.

toolsPreview.name: get_story
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one story cluster: its AI summary and key facts, plus a source-by-source timeline of every article covering the story (each with its source and a citation link). Good for "how did this story develop / who reported it".
